title.en: An Act to Provide for Assistance to the Gold Mining Industry
title.orig: An Act to Amend Sections Two, Four, Five, Six and Ten of Republic Act Numbered Thirty Hundred Eighty-Nine, as Amended, Entitled "An Act to Provide for Assistance to the Gold Mining Industry"

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1966/ra_4859_1966.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en:
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: August 2, 1966.
